turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Hale, I'm Meredith Kalinowski, Owen's mother. I have a client call at 4:40, so what I need to know is who decided on the zero, and why nobody called me before it went in.
I don't think this is productive.
Productive for whom, Hale? My son found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of class. Who decided on it?
I'm going to go. I have a class in ten minutes.
Sit down, Hale. You asked for this meeting, and I'm not leaving until I have an answer on the zero. If you walk out, I'm going to the principal's office next, and I'll want everything in writing.
Email the principal if you want. I'm done here.
I will, tonight, and it will say you asked for this meeting and then walked out of it. The zero comes off today, Hale, or the principal and I will have this conversation without you.
